To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the new EGF-PEG-LPEI carrier is a promising candidate for the development of a tumor targeted delivery system for poly(I:C) in the treatment of EGFR expressing tumors.
the novel polymeric conjugates based on 22kDa linear PEI, PEG spacers of different length, and EGF are effective carriers for poly(I:C) in tumor-targeted delivery.
the new LPEI-based conjugate is more effective than the previously developed tetraconjugate, and it is more effective in vivo than poly(I:C) alone.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of polyethylenimin (PEI) based polymeric carriers for tumor-targeted gene delivery of polyinosinic: polycytidylic (poly(I:C)) acid.
the design, synthesis, and characterization of a new class of PEI-based polymeric carriers for the delivery of poly(I:C).
the development of polyethyleniminine (PEI) based polymer conjugates for targeted delivery of cytotoxic RNA.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the LPEI-EGF-PEG conjugate is an effective and simple carrier for poly(I:C) delivery to EGFR overexpressed tumors.
the LPEI-2k-EGF conjugation is a promising approach for tumor-targeted RNA delivery.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the novel conjugate is a promising candidate for further development as a tumor-targeted polymeric carrier of poly(I:C).

we developed a novel polyetheleneimine-based polymeric carrier for the tumor-targeted delivery for cytotoxic double stranded RNA.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the use of linear PEI as carrier instead of branched PEI, and the use of a PEG spacer with a molecular weight of 2 kDa instead of 5 kDa, results in a poly(I:C)-polyplex with a higher transfection activity and a higher cytotoxicity.
it is possible to design a polymeric carrier that is chemically less complex than the previously described tetra-conjugates but still retains the same high efficacy.
a simplified carrier can be as effective as a more complex one, and thus can be more suitable for further development.
